svg.text: Many genomes narrow to the orthologs they share, pass through the tree one lineage at a time, and fan back out to one N​e proxy per species.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, '-apple-system', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: N​e proxy = count-pooled dN/dS on each species' own branch (two-ratio branch model), with a gene-bootstrap CI.
Standard-library Python; MAFFT / PAL2NAL / codeml do the alignment and model fitting. Every stage: a timestamped log and a pass/drop manifest.
run_buscomega.py orchestrates all seven · runs 3 to hundreds of taxa, any clade
